careerInfo: Ms Chan is a Non-Executive Director of the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC). She is the Senior Advisor of Chairman’s Office of Ernst & Young Greater China and has over 30 years of experience in the accounting profession. Prior to this position, she was the Managing Partner for Ernst & Young Hong Kong & Macau, overseeing all aspects of business operations in these locations.Ms Chan is active in public service. She is a member of the Election Committee in the Accountancy Subsector, the Exchange Fund Advisory Committee of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority and the Users' Committee of the Hong Kong Inland Revenue Department. She is a member of the Public Service Commission. She is also the Deputy Chairman of the General Committee and the Chairman of the Membership Committee of the Hong Kong General Chamber of Commerce, a member of the Corporate Advisory Council of the Hong Kong Securities and Investment Institute and a member of the HKSAR Government’s Advisory Panel on BEPS 2.0. In addition, Ms Chan was appointed as an Accounting Advisor (Hong Kong) by the Ministry of Finance of the People’s Republic of China, and a HKSAR delegate of the All-China Women’s Federation.Previously, Ms Chan was a member of the Competition Commission of Hong Kong, the Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Appeal Board, the Environment and Conservation Fund Committee of Hong Kong, and the Telecommunications Users and Consumers Advisory Committee of the Office of the Communications Authority.Ms Chan chairs the SFC's Audit Committee and Budget Committee. She also sits on the Remuneration Committee, Investment Committee and the SFC (HKEC Listing) Appeals Committee.
summary: Agnes Chan Sui Kuen is one of the Non-Executive Directors of HK-Securities and Futures Exchanges.

title: GBS, JP
educationInfo: Mr Cheng graduated from Cornell University with a bachelor’s degree in political science and economics, and earned a bachelor’s degree in jurisprudence and a master’s degree from Oxford University. He has been conferred Honorary Fellow by the City University of Hong Kong.
careerInfo: Mr Cheng is a Non-Executive Director of the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC). He is currently the Deputy Chairman and Chief Executive of Wing Tai Properties Limited and the Chairman of Lanson Place Hospitality Management Limited. He is also an Independent Non-Executive Director of Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong) Limited.  A qualified solicitor in England and Wales as well as in Hong Kong, Mr Cheng practised for several years at a major law firm in London, specialising in corporate finance and mergers and acquisitions. In 1995, he founded SUNDAY Communications Limited which he co-chaired until 2005.Mr Cheng has been active in public service. He is a member of the Chief Executive's Council of Advisers on Innovation and Strategic Development. He is also the Council Chairman of the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts. Previously, Mr Cheng was the Chairman of the Urban Renewal Authority and the University Grants Committee, and a board member of the Airport Authority Hong Kong. He served on the Commission on Strategic Development, the Steering Committee on Innovation and Technology, the Independent Commission Against Corruption’s Operations Review Committee and Advisory Committee on Corruption, the Executive Committee of the Hong Kong Housing Society and the Councils of the Hong Kong Institute of Education, the City University of Hong Kong, the Hong Kong Polytechnic University, and the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants.Mr Cheng sits on the SFC's Budget Committee, Remuneration Committee, SFC (HKEC Listing) Appeals Committee, Takeovers and Mergers Panel and the Takeovers Appeal Committee.
summary: Edward Cheng Wai Sun is one of the Non-Executive Directors of HK-Securities and Futures Exchanges.

title: SC
careerInfo: Mr Dawes is a Non-Executive Director of the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC). A Senior Counsel practicing from Temple Chambers in Hong Kong, Mr Dawes is a commercial litigator specialising in banking, company and securities laws.Mr Dawes is a recorder of the High Court and the Chairman of the Hong Kong Bar Association. He is also an arbitrator, a member of the Proceedings Committee of the Hong Kong International Arbitration Centre and a member of the Advisory Body appointed under Part 10A of the Arbitration Ordinance. In addition, he is a member of the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants’ Disciplinary Panel.Mr Dawes sits on the SFC's Audit Committee, Remuneration Committee, Nominations Committee and the SFC (HKEC Listing) Appeals Committee. Mr Dawes is also the Chairman of the Investor and Financial Education Council.
summary: Victor Dawes is one of the Non-Executive Directors of HK-Securities and Futures Exchanges.

careerInfo: Mr Kong is a Non-Executive Director of the Securities and Future Commission (SFC). He is Managing Director of BDO Limited in Hong Kong. Educated and qualified as a Chartered Accountant with Touché Ross in England, Mr Kong has over 35 years of professional accounting experience.Mr Kong is a Fellow Member (Practising) of the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants (HKICPA), a Fellow Member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England & Wales and CPA Australia, and a member of the Hong Kong Academy of Finance. Previously, Mr Kong was President of HKICPA and Chair of its Qualification Oversight Board, Professional Conduct Committee, Nomination Committee, Ethics Committee and Small and Medium Practices Committee, and the inaugural Chairman of its Restructuring and Insolvency Faculty­. He was also President of the Hong Kong Institute of Accredited Accounting Technicians. Mr Kong is presently a Council member of the Association of Hong Kong Accounting Advisors and an Alternate Director of the Hong Kong Association of Registered Public Interest Entity Auditors. Mr Kong has been active in public service. He is currently an Accounting Advisor (Hong Kong) appointed by the Ministry of Finance and an Election Committee Member of the HKSAR Government. He is also a member of the Independent Commission Against Corruption’s Operations Review Committee, the Securities and Futures Appeals Tribunal and Hong Kong University's Audit Committee. Previously, Mr Kong served as a member of the Standing Committee on Company Law Reform, Advisory Group on Modernisation of Corporate Insolvency Law, Appeal Panel (Housing), Board of Review Panel (Inland Revenue) and Appeal Board Panel (Town Planning). Representing Hong Kong in the international arena, Mr Kong currently chairs the International Federation of Accountants’ Small and Medium Practices (SMP) Business Support Task Force and is also a member of its SMP Advisory Group. He was an Executive Board Member of INSOL.Mr Kong is a member of the SFC's Remuneration Committee and the SFC (HKEC Listing) Appeals Committee.
summary: Johnson Kong is one of the Non-Executive Directors of HK-Securities and Futures Exchanges.

careerInfo: Dr Lin is a Non-Executive Director of the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC). Currently he is a Senior Partner of Davis Polk & Wardwell LLP. Qualified to practise law in Hong Kong and New York, Dr Lin has extensive experience in equity and debt capital markets, mergers and acquisitions and venture capital. He has over 20 years of experience advising on some of the largest and most complex transactions including on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, the Nasdaq Global Market and the New York Stock Exchange.Dr Lin has held a number of advisory and public roles. He currently serves on Disciplinary Panel A of the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants and the Process Review Panel of the Insurance Authority and in relation to the Regulation of Mandatory Provident Fund Intermediaries. He previously served as a member of the Securities and Futures Appeals Tribunal and the Appeal Panel (Housing).Dr Lin attained his J.D. degree from Harvard Law School and A.B. degree from Harvard University. He received his M.Phil and D.Phil degrees in International Relations from the University of Oxford.Dr Lin is also a Visiting Lecturer on Law at Harvard Law School where he teaches a course on "Entrepreneurship, Venture Capital and Law in China" and serves on the Dean's Asia Leadership Council.Dr Lin is the Chairman of the Investor Compensation Company Limited and the Deputy Chairman of the SFC's Audit Committee, Investment Committee and Remuneration Committee. He also sits on the SFC (HKEC Listing) Appeals Committee, Investor Compensation Fund Committee and Securities Compensation Fund Committee.
summary: James C. Dr Lin is one of the Non-Executive Directors of HK-Securities and Futures Exchanges.

title: SBS, JP
educationInfo:
Mr Lo graduated from The University of Hong Kong with a BSc (Hons) degree.

Mr Lo is Chairman of the SFC's Remuneration Committee. He is also a member of Investment Committee, Budget Committee and the SFC (HKEC Listing) Appeals Committee.
careerInfo: Mr Lo is a Non-Executive Director of the Securities and Futures Commission. He has been Director of Italade Technology Holdings since 1987. He was President and Chief Executive Officer of both Synnex Technology International (HK) Ltd and Synnex Distributions (China) Ltd until 2013.Mr Lo started his career in Government service as an Administrative Officer and served as Deputy Secretary for Trade and Industry in the Trade and Industry Branch of the Government Secretariat.Mr Lo serves on a number of community service advisory boards and committees in a personal capacity. He chairs the Governance Sub-committee of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority and is a member of its Exchange Fund Advisory Committee.Previously, Mr Lo was Chairman of the Standing Commission on Civil Service Salaries and Conditions of Service and the Independent Commission on Remuneration for Members of the Executive Council and the Legislature, and Officials under the Political Appointment System of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. He was also a member of the Public Service Commission, the Advisory Committee on Post-service Employment of Civil Servants, the Standing Commission on Disciplined Services Salaries and Conditions of Service, and the Standing Commission on Directorate Salaries and Conditions of Service.
summary: Nicky Lo Kar Chun is one of the Non-Executive Directors of HK-Securities and Futures Exchanges.

title: MH, JP
careerInfo:
Mr Wong is a Non-Executive Director of the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC). He served as an Executive Director of Sun Hung Kai Properties Group prior to his retirement in December 2009, and thereafter as a Non-Executive Director and also Group Principal Advisor until December 2013. He resigned as a Non-Executive Director in November 2015.

Mr Wong has been active in public and community services and has served on a number of Government advisory committees. Mr Wong was the Chairman of the Council of the Hong Kong Metropolitan University. He was also the Chairman of the Hong Kong Youth Hostels Association and participated in the revitalisation project of Mei Ho House in Shek Kip Mei. Currently, he is a member of the Association’s Executive Committee, a member of the Board of Trustees of New Asia College, The Chinese University of Hong Kong and the Land and Development Advisory Committee.Mr Wong obtained his Bachelor of Business Administration and Master of Business Administration degrees from The Chinese University of Hong Kong.Mr Wong is a member of the SFC's Remuneration Committee and the SFC (HKEC Listing) Appeals Committee.
summary: Michael Wong Yick Kam is one of the Non-Executive Directors of HK-Securities and Futures Exchanges.

title: JP
careerInfo: Mr Yih is a Non-Executive Director of the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC). He is currently a partner of Kwok Yih & Chan, Solicitors.Mr Yih was admitted as a solicitor in England & Wales in 1988 and subsequently in Hong Kong in 1989. He is also admitted to practise law in Australia and Singapore.Mr Yih’s public roles include serving as Chairman of the Financial Dispute Resolution Centre and Deputy Chairman of the Council of the Education University of Hong Kong. He is a member of the Education Commission, the Standing Committee on Legal Education and Training, the Standing Committee on Judicial Salaries and Conditions of Service and the Banking Review Tribunal. He is also a member of the Quality Education Fund Steering Committee and Chairman of its Dissemination and Promotion Sub-committee. He is a Non-Executive Director of the eMPF Platform Company Limited.Previously, Mr Yih was President of The Law Society of Hong Kong and Convenor of Investigation Panel A of the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants. He was also a member of the Listing Committee of the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong.Mr Yih attained his LL.B. degree from King’s College London. He is a Fellow of King’s College London.Mr Yih is a member of the SFC’s Remuneration Committee and the SFC (HKEC Listing) Appeals Committee.
summary: Dieter Yih is one of the Non-Executive Directors of HK-Securities and Futures Exchanges.
